name: Shimo-Shimmei
tagline: Shinagawa in 12 minutes and Shibuya in 23 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Shinagawa City, where Tokyu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 32 minutes to Otemachi, 28 minutes to Shinjuku, 23 minutes to Shibuya and 12 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 16 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 13.5 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 16 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 7.5 m to 21 m, a difference of 13.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 1 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 5 clinics and 3 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 仁生堂大村病院, about 17 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 佐花会大井中央病院, about 18 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Oimachi Line.
congestion: Tokyu Oimachi Line runs at 118% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 九品仏→自由が丘, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥180,000 to ¥190,000 and 2LDK ¥260,000 to ¥270,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 4 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Oimachi Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
